source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Connecting Conclusions to Hypotheses' under topic 7.7 (PDF 103, printed 99).

blocks.text: Nateeje seedha asal hypotheses se jure hone chahiye. Researchers saaf batayein ke hypothesis ki tayeed (support) hui ya nahi. Data aur test ke nataij nateeje ko sahi sabit karein. Zaati raaye aakhri nateeje par asar na dale. Wazeh rabt research ki validity (sehat) mazboot karta hai, study mein mantiqi tasalsul laata hai, aur research ka process mukammal karta hai.

blocks.title: Misaal: 7.4 wale test ki report
blocks.text: 7.4 ki misal ki wazeh report yeh kahegi: 'Humne jaancha ke kya naya tareeqa-e-tadrees number pichhle average 70 se oopar le jata hai. Is tareeqe se parhe das talaba ka average 77 (standard deviation 2.79) tha. One-tailed t-test ne t = 7.93 diya aur p 0.05 se bohat kam tha, is liye hum null hypothesis radd karte hain: tareeqa number behtar karta lagta hai. Namoona chhota aur be-tarteeb nahi chuna gaya tha, is liye bari tehqeeq ki sifarish hai.'

blocks.prompt: Report mein tehqeeq ki hudood, jaise chhota namoona, kyun batani chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Taake parhne wale nateeje par saboot se zyada bharosa na karein: chhota ya ghair-numainda namoona poori population ki akkasi nahi kar sakta, aur yeh batana abalagh ko imandar rakhta aur aage ki research ki rehnumai karta hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa: 7.7 Communicating Results and Conclusions

items: Nataij context ke saath samjhein; mubaligha na karein.
Tables, charts aur saadi zaban se nataij wazeh karein.
Har nateeja apne hypothesis se, saboot ke saath, jorein.
